text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Visiting the academy library,
I found Biwa Hayahide looking troubled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's up, Hayahide?
You've got quite the furrow in your brow.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Palmer. Actually, I have an interview scheduled for today, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For the interview theme 'The Secret to Popularity,'
I've been thinking about how to answer it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, an interview, huh.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How about using something like this for reference?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, the Academy PR magazine. Indeed, if we use
interviews with other students as a reference—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Hm? This photo is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's a photo of Nature and Turbo.
You both look great.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's such a heartwarming photo.
You can really feel their mutual respect.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what frame of mind they were in for the shoot.
If only we had time, I'd have liked to ask them—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're in luck then♪
Nature was just out in the hallway a moment ago!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Really?
Thank you, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Nature-kun, do you have a moment?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Hayahide-san?
Did you need something from me...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I wanted to ask how you felt
when you took that promotional photo.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You all had such wonderful expressions on your faces,
I really wanted to use them as reference for my coverage.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that? To tell the truth, I was keeping up with Turbo's runaway pace
and things kind of ended up like that, you could say...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, when I say running wild, it's really nothing
serious. It happens all the time anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I think that might just be one of her charms,
too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She's completely reckless, honestly.
In daily life, and during races too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Charging straight at opponents they have no chance against,
then running away with everything they've got.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I never think about pacing myself, so running out
of steam halfway through happens all the time,
but still—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
This is what it means to never give uuuuuuu
uuuuup!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: âI'll never, ever give up on winning.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Seeing them like that makes me think...
maybe I wanna win, too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ahaha...!
This really isn't like me, is it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you'd rather not, um...
please just ignore what I said...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, Nature-kun—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You met Turbo, and seeing
how hard she tried made you want to win.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —I know that feeling all too well myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing their unyielding will and hunger for victory...
My heart trembled with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And then I thought: I don't want to lose to them.
I don't want to be left behind. —"I want to win."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In the past, all I ever thought about
was "not losing."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I believe my popularity only stemmed from that sense
of stability. ...However.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Along this grueling journey, I was able to make an
irreplaceable friend.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And little by little, I changed. Yes,
as I competed and grew alongside the two of them,
I developed a fierce desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If there's truly a reason behind
her captivating popularity—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's this desire to 'win.'
A burning passion my friends taught me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide candidly shares her feelings. Just as
I'm thinking this will make for a great interview article,
suddenlyââ

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I can do it too...
I absolutely won't lose the next race!
